_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
Agpaspas ka iti Golf (Card Game) - Player {player_id}.
Goal: Makagun-od iti kababaan a puntos iti daytoy a maysa a round. No adda pagshare dagiti column iti isu met laeng a puntos, awan ti isu met a puntos.
Puntos ti card: A=1, 2-10=face value, J/Q=10, K=0

Actions (usaren exact brackets):
- '[draw]' - Draw manipud iti deck
- '[take]' - Kuha manipud iti discard pile
- '[swap X Y]' - Paltaan ti drawn card iti posision X (row) Y (column)
- '[discard]' - Taltal ti drawn card

board.drew:
Naagdraw mo: {card}
Itan ket masapul a [swap X Y] wenno [discard] iti.
board.took: Innalayo: {card} manipud iti basuraan Masapul a [swap X Y] ti isawsawmo (saan nga ilaksid).

options.final_turns: Final turns! Options mo: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: Masapul a: [swap X Y] (di mabalin nga ibelleng dagiti kard manipud iti pagibellengan)

message.deck_empty: Awanen ti adda iti deck! Agpatinggan a dagus ti ay-ayam.
message.knocked: Ti agay-ayam {pid} ket napuntaan! Tunggal maysa nga agay-ayam ti makaala iti ad-adu pay a gundaway.
message.final_round: Agmangngal ti {pid} {reason}! Makatanggap ti maysa pay a tukar dagiti dadduma a mangangal.

invalid.wrong_action: Usaren yo exactamente maysa a bracketed action: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], wenno [peek X Y]
invalid.must_draw_first: Awanan yo umuna a [draw], [take], [knock], wenno [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: Saanmo a mabalin nga ibelleng ti maysa a kard manipud iti bunton dagiti saanen a mausar. Masapul nga ibasam dayta.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Adda kayat nakadrew. Agnanayon, [swap X Y] wenno [discard]
invalid.need_drawn_swap: Kasapulam ti naipada a kard tapno mabaliwam.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: Kasapulam ti naipatarus a kard tapno maparut.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Posision awan iti pagbeddengan. Usaren yo row 1-{max_row}, column 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: Saanmo a mabalin ti agtuktok no adda naipatarus nga kard.
invalid.already_knocked: Adda nangabak iti daytoy a gimong.
